headline: Committee's motion to file resolution fails 4-5; recording ends before adoption vote

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.voteItem: Motion to amend the main motion (wording not in the recording)
meeting.summary: Member Paltin moved to file the resolution, which failed four ayes to five noes. A motion to adopt Resolution 26-130 was made and seconded, and the committee took a three-minute recess. The recording ends before any vote on adoption.
meeting.recap: The chair said the chair's changes included properties suggested by Members Cook and Sugimura and Chair Lee.[[0:03:56]] A motion to amend passed, announced as five ayes and four noes.[[0:06:36]] The main motion as amended passed, five ayes to four noes.[[0:06:55]] Tamara Paltin moved to file the resolution, which means setting it aside without adopting it.[[0:11:26]] The motion to file failed, four ayes to five noes.[[0:18:15]] A member asked how much more tax the property owed each year, and whether it had been paid.[[0:20:53]] The committee took a three-minute recess.[[0:23:19]] The recording ends before any vote on adopting the resolution.[[0:23:25]]
decided: The main motion as amended passed.
A motion to adopt Resolution 26-130 was made and seconded, but no vote is in the recording.
meeting.next: The committee took a three-minute recess so a member could get the property tax information.
